hook: All 26 handshapes of the ASL manual alphabet, any word or name fingerspelled at the speed you pick, and a reading game that speeds up every time you get one right.
outcome: Form and recognize the 26 handshapes of the ASL manual alphabet, fingerspell names with a smooth rhythm, and read short fingerspelled words
sources: Hand drawings: public domain ASL alphabet line art from wpclipart.com, via Wikimedia Commons
Practice for the manual alphabet only; learn from Deaf signers and your ASL teacher
